statements.action_statement: Use the default ES256 signing algorithm. Only a deployment that opts into RS256 (`[oauth2] signing_algorithm` or an RS256 JWS token key) performs RSA private-key operations and is exposed to the Marvin timing side channel; RSA public-key operations (verification of RS256 DPoP proofs, federation JWKS, JWS) are not affected. No patched `rsa` release exists.

statements.impact_statement: The patched line (>= 0.7.6) is already used where possible. crypto-bigint 0.5.5 stays in the tree through elliptic-curve 0.13 (p256, ecdsa, used for ES256) and rsa 0.9, which have no release on the patched line. Exploitability depends on compiler, target CPU and a local or microarchitectural observer; it has not been assessed for these call sites. Tracked in the CRA requirements page.
